name: noesis
description: Noesis is a non-clinical, source-aware self-reflection connector for published or clearly labelled psychometric instruments. The hosted MCP endpoint is https://noesis.seges.ai/mcp and uses OAuth authorization code flow with mandatory S256 PKCE. A host is supported only after its exact version completes a recorded acceptance test.
author: seges-plugin

interface.shortDescription: Non-clinical, source-aware self-reflection through a hosted MCP connector.
interface.longDescription: Noesis supports structured self-reflection with published or clearly labelled psychometric instruments and plain-language interpretation. It is not therapy, diagnosis, or treatment. A host is supported only after its exact version completes a recorded OAuth authorization-code and S256 PKCE acceptance test. Signed-in storage reads require the applicable consent and an explicit per-session source choice; stored results, profiles, and journal content are never loaded by default. Referral results are informational leads only, and users independently verify credentials, availability, scope, and suitability.
